title: canon-trigger-history/1
description: The `canon-trigger-history/1` document `canon trigger evaluate --history` reads: what the evaluator recorded, its firings, activations and approvals.

Identifier.description: A well-formed identifier is not empty, and without whitespace, control characters or Unicode format characters (general category Cf). The pattern checks only for whitespace; Canon also refuses control and Unicode format characters.

Instant.description: An instant written `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` in UTC, or with a fraction of one to nine digits after the seconds, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.fffZ`; uppercase `T` and `Z`, no leap second (`2026-10-04T12:00:00Z`, `2026-10-04T12:00:00.400Z`): when evidence was observed, and the evaluation instant. Order forms compare every instant of one evaluation at one resolution, the coarsest precision written among its records, dropping finer digits (`12:00:00.4Z` beside `12:00:00Z` reads as `12:00:00Z`); expiry reads the whole seconds and ignores the fraction. Calendar validity is checked by Canon, not by the pattern: the date must exist (leap years included) and the time be at most 23:59:59.

TriggerHistory.description: The `canon-trigger-history/1` document `canon trigger evaluate --history` reads: what the evaluator recorded, its firings, activations and approvals.

firings.description: Every recorded firing; empty when left out.

activations.description: Every activation of a rule key; empty when left out.

approvals.description: Every approval of a rule key; empty when left out.

firing_id.description: The firing id the evaluator submitted.

TriggerActivation.description: One activation of a rule key, with the rows the evaluator listed as matching then, each written `<kind>:<row id>`.

at.description: When the rule key was activated.

baseline.description: The rows that matched at activation; empty when left out.

TriggerApproval.description: One approval of a rule key: a `write` rule in mode `auto` is refused (`write-unapproved`) unless the history holds one for its exact rule key. Canon reads `by` and never decides who may approve.

by.description: Who approved, as the evaluator recorded it.
